info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts-v1-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts API provides users access to a comprehensive list of available discounts on auto insurance quotes. This API enables users to retrieve detailed information about various discounts based on factors such as driver profile and insurance type. It is particularly useful for insurance companies looking to optimize their offerings, as well as for consumers comparing quotes. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can enhance their understanding of potential savings opportunities in the auto insurance market.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of discounts applicable to their quotes. It provides essential information regarding available discounts to help users optimize their pricing.
